# 5 Star — Crafts & Construction

> A South African crafts and construction studio led by Clive, delivering bespoke joinery, home renovations, painting & tiling, plumbing, roofing & fencing, woodwork & countertops, and deck repairs & shadeports — one hand-finished standard across every trade.

## Services
- Joinery: staircases, panelling, doors, wardrobes, bespoke fitments
- Home Renovations: full-room and whole-home transformations
- Painting & Tiling: walls, floors, splashbacks
- Plumbing: repairs, reroutes, kitchen and bathroom installations
- Roofing & Fencing: repairs, weatherproofing, boundaries
- Woodwork & Countertops: kitchens, counters, cabinetry
- Deck Repairs & Shadeports: deck restoration and shade structures

## Service Areas
Knysna · Plettenberg Bay · George · Wilderness · Sedgefield · Mossel Bay · Greater Western Cape (on request)
